notes: VERBUNDEN_MIT_AKTEUR connects a person to an organisation, office, network, institution, or other actor mentioned in the actor registry context.
ASSOZIIERT_MIT_PROJEKT is a weak registry-derived project association and must not be treated as confirmed project participation.
Keep BETEILIGT_AN for project-file-confirmed participation only.

GEHÖRT_ZU models organizational hierarchy: a person/sub-org belongs to a parent organization, network, institution, or programme. Distinct from VERBUNDEN_MIT_AKTEUR (which is a softer, peer-style connection).
